title: 第3章 全知视角第4章 变脸
content_zh:
造成洪灾的仙人只有少数人看到，但镇上仙人的斗法很多人都看到了。
关于仙人的事，不仅易长生想打听，那些衙役也想知道更详细的，好几个衙役轮番的问那些镇上的灾民。
他们说话的声音不算大，但也不小，留意之下，易长生也听了个大概。
镇上的人逃离并不是单单是仙人斗法，而是在这之前就无缘无故死了很多人，那些人死后仿佛被抽干血液像干尸一样，非常可怕，这才是让镇民们主要出逃的原因。
仙人的斗法似乎是因为有仙人发现了镇上的情况，找到了另一个藏在镇上的仙人这才打了起来。
易长生简单的分析了一下，估计是邪修或是魔修遇到了正道的修仙者之类的。
听到这些消息，他心里也有些害怕，这世界太危险了，弱肉强食，没有实力遇到这种情况只能任人宰割啊！
等他吃完馕饼时，衙役们也发完了食物和药汤。
“各位，县令大人已经派人查看支风镇和各个村里的情况了，现在洪水差不多已经退去，镇上的仙人斗法也结束，镇上来的人现在都可以回去了。”
听到这话后，镇上的人们小声议论，他们还是害怕，讨论着要不要回去。
而村民们一脸麻木，他们的家都被水冲垮了，很多人都被冲走，回去也是什么都没了。
“各位受灾的村民也不用担心，下午田家和几家富户也会轮流拿食物来救济各位，县令大人已经想好怎么安置你们了，你们就放心吧。”
等衙役和大夫们走了后，易长生又钻进小树林里，离开人群往树林深处走。
他在一个小坡上找到了一个还算干净阴凉的大石块，看着周围一个人都没有，他才安心一些。
易长生直接就躺在大石上，让一直紧绷的身体和精神休息。
当然，他没敢睡死，只是让身体和精神尽量放松休息。
一直休息到下午，或许是药汤和食物的补充，再加上金手指反馈的能量被吸收了，他感觉身体和精神都好了很多。
这时易长生开始考虑以后要何去何从了。
他本来就身无分文，身上除了衣服外，只有藏在怀里他父亲送给他的一把小刀，除此之外什么也没有了。
而且，在这之前，他去过最远的地方就只有镇上，其他的地方他就没去过，对这个世界或者说对县城都不了解，只是偶尔听到有人说过县城里什么都好。

从身体那里得到的信息太少了。
易长生是不打算再回原来的那个草支村了，那个支风镇暂时也不敢去。
谁知道那仙人走了没有，而且那些邪修魔修要是不小心留下一些隐患在那，他们这些凡人怎么死都不知道啊。
想来想去还是要进县城啊！
在城里打听仙人的消息应该会更安全一些。
易长生是想去修仙的，他想打听到更多仙人的消息，只要找到仙人，找到功法，这样才有机会修仙。
但现在根本就进不了城，不过要是有钱进城应该不难。
问题是他现身无分文，想赚钱也得要进到城里才好找机会赚到大钱，没钱他就进不了城，这样就进入了死循环了。
易长生打开面板，细看虚维之眼的描述，本来还想把身体养好了再凝聚虚维之眼的，现在看来还是要靠它才行啊！
虚维之眼有主动让单位显形或是隐形的能力。
content_en:
Only a few people saw the immortal who caused the flood, but many people saw the immortal's fighting skills in the town.
Not only did Yi Changsheng want to inquire about the immortal, but the government officials also wanted to know more details. Several government officials took turns asking the victims of the town.
The voices they spoke were not too loud, but not too quiet either. After paying attention, Yi Changsheng also got a rough idea.
The people in the town fled not just because of the immortal fight, but because many people died for no reason before. Those people seemed to have their blood drained out like mummies after death. It was very scary. This was the main reason why the townspeople fled.
The fight between the immortals seems to have started because an immortal discovered the situation in the town and found another immortal hiding in the town.
Yi Changsheng made a brief analysis and estimated that it was an evil cultivator or a demonic cultivator who met a righteous cultivator.
Hearing this news, he was also a little scared. This world is too dangerous. The weak eat the strong. If you don't have the strength, you can only let others slaughter you if you encounter such a situation!
By the time he finished eating the naan bread, the government officials had finished distributing food and medicinal soup.
"Everyone, the county magistrate has sent people to check the situation in Zhifeng Town and various villages. Now the flood has almost receded and the immortal battle in the town has ended. Everyone in the town can go back now."
After hearing this, the people in the town whispered. They were still afraid and discussed whether to go back.
The villagers looked numb. Their homes were destroyed by the water, many people were washed away, and they had nothing when they returned.
"Don't worry about the affected villagers. The Tian family and several wealthy households will take turns bringing food to you in the afternoon. The county magistrate has already figured out how to resettle you, so don't worry."
After the government officials and doctors left, Yi Changsheng got into the woods again, leaving the crowd and walking deeper into the woods.
He found a relatively clean and cool large rock on a small slope. Seeing that there was no one around, he felt relieved.
Yi Changsheng lay directly on the big stone to rest his tense body and mind.
Of course, he didn't dare to sleep to death, he just wanted to relax his body and mind as much as possible.
He rested until the afternoon. Perhaps due to the supplement of medicinal soup and food, and the absorption of the energy fed back by the golden finger, he felt much better physically and mentally.
At this time, Yi Changsheng began to think about where to go in the future.
He was originally penniless. Apart from his clothes, he only had a knife hidden in his arms that his father gave him, and nothing else.
Moreover, before this, the farthest place he had been was the town. He had never been to other places. He didn't know much about the world or the county. He only occasionally heard someone say that everything in the county was good.
Getting too little information from the body.
Yi Changsheng has no plans to go back to his original Caozhi Village, and he doesn't dare to go to Zhifeng Town for the time being.
Who knows if the immortal is gone, and if those evil cultivators accidentally leave some hidden dangers there, mortals like them will die without knowing it.
After much deliberation, I still have to go to the county seat!
It should be safer to inquire about the Immortal in the city.
Yi Changsheng wanted to cultivate immortality. He wanted to find out more news about immortals. As long as he found the immortals and the techniques, he would have a chance to cultivate immortality.
But now it's impossible to enter the city, but if you have money, it shouldn't be difficult.
The problem is that he is penniless. If he wants to make money, he has to go to the city to find opportunities to make big money. Without money, he can't go to the city, thus entering an endless loop.
Yi Changsheng opened the panel and looked carefully at the description of the Eye of Xuwei. He originally wanted to heal his body and then condense the Eye of Xuwei, but now it seems that he still has to rely on it!
The Eye of Virtual Dimension has the ability to actively make units visible or invisible.
